Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Template:Ambox
History: https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Template:Ambox&action=history
Revision: https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Template:Ambox&oldid=1377691028 (09/30/2026 4:25 PM UTC)
Adapted by phpBB Modders.
Changes: rewritten in plain wiki text without Lua (Module:Message box): a one-cell table with the text, or the issue and the fix, and the date in brackets; no image, type colours, small, talk or category options, since the wiki allows no images in templates, no styles and no <div>; &nbsp; where {{#if:}} would trim a space; removed the source's documentation and categories.
Example: {{Ambox|issue=This article needs work.|fix=Please help.}}
Example: {{Ambox|text=Plain notice text.}}
Example: {{Ambox|issue=Needs work.|date=October 2026}}

</noinclude><table><tr><td>{{#if:{{{text|}}}|{{{text}}}|{{{issue|}}}{{#if:{{{fix|}}}|&nbsp;{{{fix}}}}}}}{{#if:{{{date|}}}|&nbsp;[i]({{{date}}})[/i]}}</td></tr></table>
